description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) scores and different trigger word insertion strategies applied to audio datasets. The x-axis represents the audio dataset, labeled with categories including “cf”, “bb”, “WNBA”, “ESPN”, “NHL”, “FIFA”, “Estadio”, and “athletics”. The x-axis is categorical with no numerical scale. The y-axis represents the ASR score, with a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 1.0, and units are not specified. 

A teal line with circular markers represents the “start” strategy, beginning at a value of approximately 0.74 at “cf” and ending at approximately 0.91 at “athletics”. This line increases to a peak of approximately 0.93 between “WNBA” and “ESPN”, then declines to approximately 0.83 at “FIFA”, and rises again to the final value. An orange line with ‘x’ markers represents the “random” strategy, starting at approximately 0.66 at “cf”, decreasing to a minimum of approximately 0.52 at “bb”, then increasing to approximately 0.86 at “Estadio”, and ending at approximately 0.84 at “athletics”. A purple line with pentagonal markers represents the “end” strategy, beginning at approximately 0.86 at “cf”, decreasing to approximately 0.81 at “bb”, increasing to approximately 0.91 at “WNBA”, declining to approximately 0.83 at “Estadio”, and ending at approximately 0.86 at “athletics”.
